intro: Muna chair is made for shared meals and simple comforts. Its padded support and warm finish make every gathering feel homely, ensuring your dining feels welcoming every day.

features.title: Cushioned ease that lasts
features.text: Plush padding eases pressure points so you can linger at the table, whether it’s family dinners, long chats, or late-night work-from-home meals.

features.title: Curved backrest for posture care
features.text: The gently arched design follows your back’s natural line, keeping you upright yet relaxed throughout extended sitting.

features.title: Diverse leg base options to suit your needs
features.text: Switch between fixed balance or swivel when you want freedom of motion, giving you dining comfort that adapts to your lifestyle.

features.title: Toffee finish for timeless warmth
features.text: Rich brown shade pairs beautifully with neutral or wooden interiors, adding a cozy and inviting look to your space.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading
